title: Personal Annotation interpretation (Workbench v1)
description: Research classification of Personal Annotation evidence. Original annotation text is preserved by the Workbench/input layer, not by the LLM.

pattern.description: Evidence type. Length is a feature, never a hard rule.

summary.description: Short Chinese explanation of how the annotation was used as evidence.

tag_like_signals.description: Optional extracted tag-like fragments (e.g. 比喻, 拟人). Not reconciled here.

character_like_signals.description: Research-only. Do not create Character relationships or Theme/Device assignments from these.

used_as_evidence_for_concepts.description: Whether any free theme/device concept was materially influenced by the annotation.
